evidence.title: OpenAI、ChatGPT広告を26カ国へ拡大 広告主は10万社超
evidence.body: [e002:f01] 広告提供の開始から8カ月余りで、キャンペーンを実施した広告主は10万社を超えた。 [e002:f02] 今回の拡大では、アルゼンチン、チリ、コロンビア、ペルーなど中南米の14カ国に加え、ナイジェリア、南アフリカ、セルビア、ウクライナ、カンボジア、バングラデシュ、パキスタンなどで提供を開始。 [e002:f03] 広告主は、テクノロジーパートナー経由、または広告マネージャーのセルフサービス機能を使って出稿できる。 [e002:f04] ChatGPT広告は、ユーザーが会話を通じて商品やサービスを探し、比較・検討する場面で、関連する選択肢を提示するもの。 [e002:f05] 広告の表示対象はFreeとGoプランで、Plus、Pro、Enterpriseには引き続き表示しない。 [e002:f06] 広告には広告であることを明示し、ChatGPTの回答と分けて表示する。 [e002:f07] また、広告が回答内容に影響することはなく、会話を広告主に開示したり、ユーザーのデータを販売したりすることもないとしている。 [e002:f08] 今後は、広告フォーマットやキャンペーンの目的、広告購入オプション、効果測定機能を拡充。 [e002:f09] ChatGPTの利用体験に自然に組み込める広告のあり方も検討する。

evidence.title: Insight secures OpenAI Advanced Partner status, launches Centre of Excellence
evidence.body: [e004:f01] [Image 1](https:// Insight Enterprises has been named an OpenAI Advanced Partner in the OpenAI Partner Network as organisations seek specialised AI support. [e004:f02] The VAR will work with OpenAI to help midmarket and lower-enterprise organisations build, deploy and scale AI solutions responsibly. [e004:f03] The company has also committed to launching a dedicated OpenAI Centre of Excellence, and expanding its capabilities across its sales, solution architecture and engineering. [e004:f04] The move comes as growing numbers of organisations seek support around governance, adoption, security and deployment and operations of AI projects, creating new opportunities for channel partners. [e004:f05] The partnership follows OpenAI’s launch of the OpenAI Partner Network in June, backed by $150m (£111.7m) in funding. ### OpenAI and the channel: Open AI Partner Network “This is a massive opportunity for any partner out there,” Colleen Kapase, VP of global strategic partners and ecosystem for [**OpenAI, told**_**CRN**_](https:// "OpenAI, told CRN") following the launch of the partner programme. [e004:f06] “We have 900 million weekly active users of OpenAI technology - 900 million weekly - that’s amazing. [e004:f07] “Partners do not want to miss this opportunity. [e004:f08] “We’re really showing here that we need these partners, we care about them, we’re co-investing with them, and we’re going to do some amazing things together.” The partnership combines OpenAI’s models and products with Insight’s expertise in AI, cloud, cybersecurity, data and digital transformation, and will focus on tackling the governance, adoption and operational challenges that prevent AI projects from delivering valuable business outcomes. [e004:f10] “As an OpenAI Advanced Partner, we can help more organisations deploy AI responsibly, scale across the enterprise, and realise value at speed.” Insight says its **[own experience deploying AI](https:// "own experience deploying AI")** internally has informed its customer strategy, and claims that AI has been adopted by more than 90 per cent of its global workforce, generating productivity gains and providing lessons it can apply when helping customers scale AI initiatives. [e004:f11] “Successful AI transformation requires both breakthrough technology and proven delivery expertise,” said Colleen Kapase, VP of strategic global partnerships and ecosystems at OpenAI. [e004:f12] “Insight's customer reach, technical capabilities, and focus on business outcomes make them a valuable partner for organisations adopting AI. [e004:f13] “Working together, we can help more organisations accelerate the journey from AI exploration to real-world impact.”。

evidence.title: OpenAI、意思決定APIを全面開放 応答時間を100ミリ秒に短縮
evidence.body: [e005:f01] 10月22日、同社は全顧客向けに意思決定インターフェース「Decisions API」を正式開放すると発表した。 [e005:f02] このインターフェースはGPT-6 Lunaを基に最適化され、一部タスクの応答時間を1～3秒から100～180ミリ秒に短縮、1回のリクエストで最大400問を処理でき、音声・視覚モダリティも追加された。 [e005:f03] Datadog、Ramp、Speak、Boxなどが既に一部の大規模モデル呼び出しを置き換え、遅延とコストの改善を実現している。 [e005:f04] 本製品はTypeSafeのJevモデルに直接対抗するが、第三者ランキングでは評価が分かれ、AIMultipleとArtificial Analysisの指数でJevはそれぞれ7位と2位、OpenAIは14位と11位となった。 [e005:f05] このインターフェースは推論モデルGPT-6 Lunaを基に最適化されたもので、一部タスクでは応答時間を1～3秒から100～180ミリ秒に短縮できる。 [e005:f06] OpenAIのAPI製品責任者ニクンジ・ハンダ氏は、チームがTypeSafeのJevモデルを見てこうした製品に多くの潜在シナリオがあると気付き、その後、専用の意思決定モデルを一から訓練するのではなく、既存の基盤モデルを改造することを決めたと述べた。 [e005:f07] このインターフェースは9月29日の開発者デーイベントで初めて公表され、10月6日に公開テストを開始、10月22日にテストを終えて正式リリースされた。 [e005:f08] 初期顧客の実測：速度とコストがともに改善 複数の企業が既にDecisions APIで一部の大規模モデル呼び出しを置き換えている。 [e005:f09] 語学学習プラットフォームのSpeakはGPT-Live内のユーザー操作間の待ち時間を1.4秒から0.13秒に短縮し、削減幅は90％超となった。 [e005:f10] 企業 応用シーン 効果 Datadog AIエージェントが生成するコマンドのリスク評価 P95遅延が約40倍高速化 Ramp AI呼び出しコストを具体的タスクに帰属 速度4倍向上、コスト30％削減 Speak 語学学習アプリ内の操作連携 待ち時間が1.4秒から0.13秒に短縮 Box 商業文書の分類とフロー振り分け 保険証券審査などのフローに活用 注：データはOpenAIが公表した顧客事例による。 [e005:f11] TypeSafeは9月15日に初のSystem Oneモデル「Jev」を発表した。 [e005:f12] AIMultipleが発表したSystem One Indexでは、最新Jevが7位、OpenAIのDecisions APIが14位。 [e005:f13] 意思決定モデルにリアルタイムでパックマンをプレイさせ、各モデルがゲーム内のゴーストと100局対戦、平均得点で順位を付け、同時に生存時間、応答遅延、1局あたりのコストを記録する。 [e005:f14] 結果は、Jev 1.14が平均3597点で1位、GPT-6 Lunaが平均2568点で8位だった。 [e005:f15] Opper AIの最高成長責任者フェリックス・ヴンダーリヒ氏は、この古典的ゲームが意思決定モデルのテストに適しているのは「各交差点でモデルが数百ミリ秒以内にどちらへ進むか決めなければならない」からだと述べた。 [e005:f16] 低コスト意思決定が新たなシーンを開く可能性 意思決定モデルに共通する売りはスループットとコストである。

evidence.title: AIM Intelligence、OpenAI「Daybreak」を組み込んだアプリセキュリティ評価を提供開始
evidence.body: [e006:f01] AIM Intelligenceは23日、自社のAIレッドチームソリューション「Stinger」とOpenAIのサイバーセキュリティプログラム「Daybreak」を連携させたセキュリティ評価サービスを公開したと明らかにした。 [e006:f02] AIアプリやウェブサービス、APIを対象に、Daybreak Blueモデルによるコード脆弱性分析にStingerのテスト技術と専門家のレビューを加え、実際のリスク度と対応優先順位を判断し、再現証拠と対応ガイドを提供する。 [e006:f03] 同社はOpenAIパートナーネットワークのセレクトパートナーとして、企業向けアプリセキュリティへ協力範囲を拡大した。 [e006:f04] 今後はStarfortを軸にAIリスク評価・統制技術の高度化も進める計画だ。 [e006:f05] AIセキュリティ専門企業のAIM Intelligenceが、OpenAIのサイバーセキュリティプログラムと自社のレッドチームソリューションを組み合わせたアプリケーションセキュリティ評価サービスを打ち出し、両社の協力範囲を企業向けアプリセキュリティへと広げた。 [e006:f06] Daybreak Blueモデルでコードの脆弱性を分析するブルーチーム方式に、Stingerのテスト技術と同社専門家のレビューを重ねる構造だ。 [e006:f07] 潜在的な脆弱性をアプリケーションの権限や設定、データフローに至るまで併せて精査し、実際のリスク度と対応優先順位を判断する。 [e006:f08] 検証を終えた脆弱性には再現証拠と対応ガイドを付けて結果を提供する。 [e006:f09] セキュリティ人材が不足する組織でも、改善措置に必要な根拠を確保できるようにするというのが同社の説明だ。 [e006:f10] AIM Intelligenceは、OpenAIパートナーネットワークの「セレクトパートナー（Select Partner）」の資格で今回の協力を主導した。 [e006:f11] 同社は前日の22日、ソウルのラウムアートセンターで開かれた「OpenAI DevDay Exchange Seoul」でセレクトパートナーとして紹介され、会場のパートナーブースでStingerとDaybreakを連携させたセキュリティ評価サービスの主要機能と活用方法を実演した。 [e006:f12] Yoo Sang-yoon AIM Intelligence代表は「AIが識別したリスクを実際のアプリケーション環境で検証し、エンジニアリングチームが措置に踏み切れる根拠を提供することが重要だ」と述べ、「StingerとDaybreakを組み合わせ、各組織のコードとサービス環境に基づくセキュリティ検証を提供し、より多くのチームがこれを日常的な開発・運用プロセスで活用できるよう後押ししたい」と語った。 [e006:f13] 同社はStingerとリアルタイムAIガードレール「Starfort」を軸に、AIシステムのリスクを評価・統制する技術も引き続き高度化する計画だ。 [e006:f14] 生成AIの導入が急速に増えるなか、モデル自体の脆弱性だけでなく、モデルを包むアプリケーションやAPIで生じるセキュリティリスクが新たな管理課題として浮上している状況が背景にある。 [e006:f15] 脆弱性の検出にとどまらず、組織ごとの環境でリスク度を検証して優先順位を示す点で、十分なセキュリティ組織を持たない企業にも実質的な措置の根拠を提供できると同社は期待している。 [e006:f16] ただ、AIベースの脆弱性分析結果を実際の運用環境に適用する過程では、誤検知と未検知を選別する検証手続きが鍵になるとみられる。

evidence.body: [e001:f01] 「SafetyIDs」で悪用対策を強化 編集部：吹越友一 2026年10月23日 10:51 OpenAIは10月21日、同社のAIモデルを提供するすべてのサービス間で安全性ポリシーや利用基準を統一する方針を発表した。 [e001:f02] 「GPT-6 Astra」などのモデルは、開発者や企業が構築できるものの可能性を広げる一方で、悪用のリスクも高まっている。 [e001:f03] これに伴い同社は、安全対策が有効に機能し、一貫して適用されるよう取り組んでいるという。 [e001:f04] 11月20日に発効する改定後の利用ポリシーでは、モデルルーターやAIゲートウェイなど、モデルへの直接アクセスを提供するサービスに対して事前に審査と承認を受けることが義務化される。 [e001:f05] さらに、エンドユーザーの身元を知ることなく、個々のユーザーを区別できるようになる「SafetyIDs」なども順次導入される。 [e001:f06] 同社は、モデルの能力が高まるにつれ、悪用の検出、調査、対応の方法も改善し続けるとしたうえで、明確なルールと一貫した安全対策を整備することで、開発者や企業が安心してAI技術を活用できる環境を整えていくとしている。 [e001:f07] URL 🔗ニュースリリース https:// 🔗OpenAI https://。

evidence.title: OpenAI brings frontier AI models to Google Cloud, expanding beyond Microsoft
evidence.body: [e002:f01] [Image 20: OpenAI co-founder and CEO Sam Altman. ](https:// OpenAI co-founder and CEO Sam Altman. [FP Tech Desk](http:// 21, 2026, 22:48:53 IST See more of our coverage in your search results. [Add Firstpost on Google](https:// OpenAI and Google Cloud have partnered to bring OpenAI’s frontier models and Codex agentic workflows to Google Cloud’s Model Garden. [e002:f02] The integration will give customers native access to these models to power complex agentic workflows at scale, backed by Google Cloud’s data governance and high-performance infrastructure. [e002:f03] The new deal reflects OpenAI’s growing push to expand the distribution of its technology to enterprise developers. [e002:f04] That is critical as the ChatGPT creator looks to build its business beyond its consumer offerings. [e002:f05] The move also makes OpenAI’s models available across all three of the top cloud infrastructure providers. [e002:f06] With the new change, Google Cloud customers will be able to purchase OpenAI’s frontier models through Model Garden, with transactions handled through the Google Cloud Marketplace. [e002:f07] Enterprises with Google Cloud commitments will be able to draw down those commitments to pay for these purchases. evidence.body: [e003:f01] OpenAI has hired former AWS partner sales leader Ignacio Guillen as its new partner director in charge of go-to-market for the AI superstar. [e003:f02] “At AWS, I helped businesses adopt cloud technology,” Guillen said in a LinkedIn post announcing his hiring. [e003:f03] I’m excited to bring that experience to OpenAI and continue working with customers and partners,” said Guillen, OpenAI’s new go-to-market partner director. [e003:f04] Guillen spent over eight years at AWS from 2018 until April 2026. [e003:f05] His most recent role was senior leader of partner sales for AWS’ commercial accounts. [Related: AWS Reject AI Model Monopoly, Backs OpenAI And Anthropic Models; Channel Chief Says No ‘One Model To Rule Them All’ ] Guillen also held AWS partner sales leadership and management roles around enterprise accounts, as well as SMB and startup accounts over his tenure. [e003:f06] OpenAI Hiring Cloud Channel Exec Talent; Launches OpenAI Partner Network Guillen adds to OpenAI’s growing partner executive leadership team hailing from cloud providers like AWS and Google Cloud. [e003:f07] This year, Google Cloud’s global partner programs leader, Colleen Kapase, left to join OpenAI. [e003:f08] In addition, Google Cloud’s partner network managing director, Philip Larson, recently departed to join OpenAI. [e003:f09] Last month, OpenAI hired former Google and AWS executive Brian Kane as its new director of cloud partnerships. [e003:f10] This summer, OpenAI officially launched its flagship inaugural partner program: the OpenAI Partner Network. [e003:f11] OpenAI is initially investing $150 million in the channel with the launch of the OpenAI Partner Network to support and help partners bring the benefits of AI to more organizations more quickly. [e003:f12] AWS Partner CEO: Hirings Boost Partnership Justin Copie, CEO of AWS partner Innovative Solutions, said OpenAI is making waves in the channel this year with the hiring of top talent and seeking partners to get skilled on OpenAI technology tied to cloud providers. [e003:f13] Copie believes it’s beneficial to have OpenAI partner executives who have top-notch experience working at cloud leaders like AWS and Google Cloud so they can hit the channel ecosystem ground running. [e003:f14] “We’re going to be building this OpenAI partnership with confidence,” Copie added. [e003:f16] We’re going to actually be releasing some things over the next few weeks with OpenAI specifically to start migrating those OpenAI workloads onto AWS versus Azure.” Guillen’s Channel Career At Google, Eliza And Cisco Meraki Over the past nearly two decades, Guillen has worked at companies including Google, Cisco Meraki and global manufacturer Venair Group in various sales and management roles.

evidence.body: [e003:f01] 市場関係者の話によると、OpenAI向けに米オハイオ州で大規模なAIデータセンターを建設している同社は、新規株式公開（IPO）の時期を今年12月、あるいは最遲で来年に延期することを検討している。 [e003:f02] 当初は早ければ9月の上場を予定していたが、この計画は事実上頓挫した。 [e003:f03] 同社はOpenAI向けに米オハイオ州で8.5GWのAIデータセンターを建設中で、契約済みのデータセンター収入は4,300億ドル（約67.4兆円）に達する。 [e003:f04] しかし、施設の稼働は2028年以降に段階的に始まるため、上期の売上高はわずか1.39億ドル（約220億円）にとどまる。 [e003:f05] 投資銀行が提示した600億ドル（約9.4兆円）の評価額は売上高倍率（PSR）200倍超に相当し、投資家の理解を得るのは難しい状況だ。 [e003:f06] SB Energy経営陣は来月のAnthropic上場の動向を注視しており、12月の公募実施を進めるかどうかの判断材料とする構えだ。 [e003:f07] SB Energyは9月2日に目論見書を公開し、同月21日には修正版を提出した。 [e003:f08] 評価額と現実の乖離 SB EnergyのIPOでは当初、50億〜70億ドル（約7,800億〜1.1兆円）を調達し、オハイオ州のデータセンター建設に充てる計画だった。 [e003:f09] SB Energyの契約済みデータセンター収入総額は4,300億ドル（約67.4兆円）に上り、その大半はオハイオ州の施設によるものだ。 [e003:f10] つまり4,300億ドルは複数年にまたがる契約規模であり、現金資産でも、これらの収入の現在価値でもない。 [e003:f11] これに対し、SB Energyの今年上期の売上高はわずか1.39億ドル（約220億円）、年換算で約2.78億ドル（約440億円）にとどまり、大半は既存の電力販売事業によるものだ。 [e003:f12] 600億ドルの評価額をこの売上高で割ると、売上高倍率（PSR）は200倍を超え、一般上場企業の評価水準をはるかに上回る。 [e003:f13] SB Energyの主要指標 金額／規模 投資銀行評価額 約600億ドル 契約済みデータセンター収入 4,300億ドル 当初のIPO調達額 50億〜70億ドル 上期売上高 1.39億ドル（年換算2.78億ドル） オハイオ州施設の計画規模 8.5GW エヌビディアの信用保証 1,050億ドル 施設稼働スケジュール 2028年以降に段階的 注：評価額と調達額は市場報道のレンジ。 [e003:f14] 信用デフォルトスワップ（CDS）価格は以前、約4年ぶりの高値まで上昇しており、23日は取引中の下げの大半を取り戻して0.02%安で引けたものの、短期的な持ち直しは市場の資金調達負担に対する厳しい目を変えてはいない。 [e003:f15] Anthropic上場が試金石に SB Energy経営陣は、来月の感謝祭前に予定されるAnthropicの大型IPOを注視している。 [e003:f16] データセンター運営会社でエヌビディアの算力賃貸プラットフォームであるNscaleは、潜在投資家から評価額に疑問視の声があるものの、予定通り秋の上場を計画し、目標評価額は約300億ドル（約4.7兆円）。

evidence.title: Newey on Honda progress 'disappointment' and signs for 2027
evidence.body: [e003:f01] But despite a clearly cautious choice of words throughout, Newey gave enough away about both the 'disappointment' of Honda's 2026 progress and the "hope" of what's to come next year. [e003:f02] Honda's ADUO updates - both the internal combustion engine and turbo steps that have been introduced - have fallen short of being able to help Aston Martin fight regularly for points, but equally talk for a while now has been about the focus being on bigger progress in 2027. [e003:f03] There was no denying from Newey though that, from the depths of how bad things were back at the season opener in Melbourne, steps forward had perhaps not been as much as he nor Honda wanted. [e003:f04] Asked by The Race about if things had moved forward as much as Honda had anticipated, Newey - with a wry smile, and after a pause - said: "I think it's fair to say that Honda have probably been a little bit disappointed with how much progress they have managed to make this year. [e003:f05] "But as always, or as is so often the case in that situation, it only strengthens resolve to go forward in the future. [e003:f06] The future is obviously the important bit for both companies. [e003:f07] "They are very determined. [e003:f08] These things don't change overnight, but they have a lot of good people, a lot of good processes now in place." Newey could easily have pointed the finger at Honda over the fact things remain difficult for Aston Martin at this stage of the campaign, but he was clearly eager not to rock the boat. [e003:f09] "[In terms of] relative deficit between chassis and engine...it's probably not for me to say," he said. [e003:f10] "I think if people look at the GPS [data], then you can start to get a much better picture from that." But while telling people where to look for what was happening now, he talked of hope for the future. [e003:f11] "Honda obviously are working hard," he said. [e003:f12] We are working closely with them, and so [are] hopeful of the future." Honda looks set to revamp its power unit design for next year as part of a reshuffle of the rules that involves the fuel-flow rate increasing and boost pressure being lifted. [e003:f13] Newey certainly hinted at progress coming out of Honda's Sakura base in Japan about what was being lined up for 2027. [e003:f14] "There's a lot of energy and projects on the way now that perhaps are in their early stages of development, but we see a lot of promise from those," he said. [e003:f15] "It's too early to comment on exactly where the power unit will be at the start of the season and whether then, assuming it's allowed under the PUAC [Power Unit Advisory Committee], there will be a further development for what will be race eight at the end of the first period.” That latter comment suggests more ADUO steps are in the offing, with Honda's large deficit this year allowing two further homologation upgrade opportunities in 2027 irrespective of how well it starts next season. evidence.title: Plans Approved For Affordable Senior Housing at Laguna Honda Hospital Campus, San Francisco
evidence.body: [e005:f01] The project, newly addressed as 356-402 West Clarendon Road, will replace a vacant lot within the medical campus with 159 apartments, community space, and a childhood day care center. [e005:f02] Mercy Housing is the project sponsor. [e005:f03] Alongside the planning approval, new building permits have been filed for the complex and are awaiting issuance. [e005:f04] The 68-foot-tall structure will yield around 120,000 square feet, including 98,970 square feet for housing, 9,350 square feet for parking, 1,230 square feet for residential services, 2,420 square feet for a senior center, and nearly 7,000 square feet for a children’s daycare center. [e005:f05] Residential amenities will include a community room, two laundry rooms, and the landscaped ground-level courtyard. [e005:f06] Laguna Honda Senior Housing facade elevation, illustration by Herman Coliver Locus Architecture The offices will provide a space for an In-Home Supportive Services provider to deliver care to residents. [e005:f07] The senior center will be available to residents in the new building and surrounding area, while the childhood education center will have capacity for approximately 50 children between the ages of 0 and 4. [e005:f08] The podium garage will provide space for 31 cars and 18 bicycles. [e005:f09] The application invoked Senate Bill 423 and the State Density Bonus law to streamline the approval process and increase residential capacity above base zoning. [e005:f10] Nearly all units will be one-bedroom apartments, except for a two-bedroom unit for the on-site resident manager. [e005:f11] Half of the affordable units will be designated as mobility units, and 10% will be designed to assist hearing- or visually impaired individuals. [e005:f12] Laguna Honda Senior Housing site plan, illustration by Herman Coliver Locus Architecture The roughly 1.5-acre hilltop property is located within the sprawling 75-acre Laguna Honda Hospital campus, close to the Forest Hill light-rail station. [e005:f13] Future residents will live in a topographically cloistered section of San Francisco surrounded by trees and rolling hills. [e005:f14] Laguna Honda Hospital Senior Housing site, image via Google Satellite The approval letter was filed less than a year after the city received the initial notice of intent. [e005:f15] Cahill and Guzman Construction Group will be joint general contractors. evidence.title: Newey on Honda progress 'disappointment' and signs for 2027
evidence.body: [e002:f01] But despite a clearly cautious choice of words throughout, Newey gave enough away about both the 'disappointment' of Honda's 2026 progress and the "hope" of what's to come next year. [e002:f02] Honda's ADUO updates - both the internal combustion engine and turbo steps that have been introduced - have fallen short of being able to help Aston Martin fight regularly for points, but equally talk for a while now has been about the focus being on bigger progress in 2027. [e002:f03] There was no denying from Newey though that, from the depths of how bad things were back at the season opener in Melbourne, steps forward had perhaps not been as much as he nor Honda wanted. [e002:f04] Asked by The Race about if things had moved forward as much as Honda had anticipated, Newey - with a wry smile, and after a pause - said: "I think it's fair to say that Honda have probably been a little bit disappointed with how much progress they have managed to make this year. [e002:f05] "But as always, or as is so often the case in that situation, it only strengthens resolve to go forward in the future. [e002:f06] The future is obviously the important bit for both companies. [e002:f07] "They are very determined. [e002:f08] These things don't change overnight, but they have a lot of good people, a lot of good processes now in place." Newey could easily have pointed the finger at Honda over the fact things remain difficult for Aston Martin at this stage of the campaign, but he was clearly eager not to rock the boat. [e002:f09] "[In terms of] relative deficit between chassis and engine...it's probably not for me to say," he said. [e002:f10] "I think if people look at the GPS [data], then you can start to get a much better picture from that." But while telling people where to look for what was happening now, he talked of hope for the future. [e002:f11] "Honda obviously are working hard," he said. [e002:f12] We are working closely with them, and so [are] hopeful of the future." Honda looks set to revamp its power unit design for next year as part of a reshuffle of the rules that involves the fuel-flow rate increasing and boost pressure being lifted. [e002:f13] Newey certainly hinted at progress coming out of Honda's Sakura base in Japan about what was being lined up for 2027. [e002:f14] "There's a lot of energy and projects on the way now that perhaps are in their early stages of development, but we see a lot of promise from those," he said. [e002:f15] "It's too early to comment on exactly where the power unit will be at the start of the season and whether then, assuming it's allowed under the PUAC [Power Unit Advisory Committee], there will be a further development for what will be race eight at the end of the first period.” That latter comment suggests more ADUO steps are in the offing, with Honda's large deficit this year allowing two further homologation upgrade opportunities in 2027 irrespective of how well it starts next season. [e002:f16] Advertisement 00:00。

evidence.title: Ferrari's most significant F1 aero upgrade of 2026 revealed
evidence.body: [e003:f01] This was anticipated to be an important package but both Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc played down the step forward that was anticipated from the latest developments being added to its car for this weekend's race at the Circuit of the Americas. [e003:f02] Hamilton said on Thursday: "We have a very, very small upgrade this weekend. [e003:f03] It's less than a tenth. [e003:f04] It's like half a tenth." However, in the official FIA submission where each team has to declare what it has brought, the Ferrari changes are quite extensive in performance critical areas. [e003:f05] They include an updated board brace layout, and a redesigned front floor leading edge, as well as a reshaping of both inboard vertical and horizontal board elements. [e003:f06] Furthermore, the shape of the sidepod inlet and undercut has been altered to help airflow better interact with the floor below. [e003:f07] On top of this, Ferrari has a revised diffuser volume, with new fence loading and trailing edge outboard furniture. [e003:f08] The team said the updates are focused on increasing floor downforce at both the front and rear of the car, as well as increasing energy levels and flow stability towards the back. [e003:f09] McLaren updates brake ducts and diffuser McLaren has brought further upgrades to its car at Austin, with brake-duct revisions at the front and rear to help improve flow conditioning and increase downforce. [e003:f10] The team has also tweaked its diffuser geometry to improve airflow and increase downforce across the speed range. [e003:f11] This is for evaluation purposes so far. [e003:f12] Racing Bulls's step Racing Bulls has also used the US GP weekend to introduce a hefty update package as it bids to secure its best-of-the-rest status behind the top-four teams. [e003:f13] Other teams' changes Audi has made revisions to its front brake duct as well as introducing new floorboard geometry to improve local flow conditioning. [e003:f14] Alpine has reprofiled the second- and third-element flaps of its rear wing to improve airflow conditioning, and has redesigned its rear floor corner to help increase downforce. [e003:f15] Cadillac has updated its forward floor geometry and tweaked the cooling louvres on its sidepods. [e003:f16] Advertisement 00:00。

evidence.title: Mercedes delays F1 engine upgrade as Russell faces another grid penalty
evidence.body: [e004:f01] Mercedes will not introduce its long-awaited Formula 1 engine upgrade at the United States Grand Prix, with the revised power unit also unlikely to be ready for Mexico City. [e004:f02] São Paulo has emerged as the earliest possible debut, complicating George Russell's plans to combine the performance improvement with another grid penalty. [e004:f03] News Summary Mercedes has postponed its ADUO engine upgrade beyond Austin , with Mexico City also considered unlikely and São Paulo emerging as the earliest possible introduction. [e004:f04] George Russell is expected to incur another grid penalty when he receives new power-unit components, having already exceeded his permitted allocation. [e004:f05] Both Mercedes drivers will use the latest chassis specification in Austin, despite the engine upgrade remaining unavailable. [e004:f06] The decision affects George Russell in particular, with the British driver planning to combine the introduction of the updated engine with an unavoidable grid penalty. [e004:f07] Why Mercedes has delayed its ADUO engine upgrade Mercedes received permission to develop its combustion engine under Formula 1’s ADUO system, which allows manufacturers whose power units fall behind the performance benchmark to introduce additional upgrades. [e004:f08] The mechanism was incorporated into the 2026 regulations to prevent manufacturers from remaining at a significant disadvantage throughout the new technical cycle. [e004:f09] The FIA’s assessment placed Mercedes more than 2% behind the leading combustion engine, operated by Red Bull Powertrains-Ford, making the German manufacturer eligible for an additional development opportunity. [e004:f10] George Russell (Photo: Mercedes) Russell must reconsider when to take another engine penalty Russell’s season has been complicated by reliability problems and the resulting consumption of his permitted power-unit components. [e004:f11] The British driver was forced to retire from the Malaysian Grand Prix following an engine problem, which affected Mercedes’ plans for the closing stages of the championship. [e004:f12] Why a new Mercedes engine could trigger another grid penalty Formula 1 limits the number of power-unit components each driver may use during a championship season. [e004:f13] A driver who installs an additional component beyond the permitted allocation receives a grid penalty under the sporting regulations. [e004:f14] Russell previously discussed how the team intended to combine its engine development and component-allocation strategy, as detailed in GRANDE PRÊMIO ‘s analysis of Mercedes’ ADUO upgrade and his potential grid penalty . [e004:f15] However, Antonelli’s component usage differs from Russell’s, meaning any additional grid penalty will depend on which elements are replaced. [e004:f16] Mercedes brings chassis upgrades to Austin despite engine delay The delay to the engine programme does not mean Mercedes has stopped developing the W17.

evidence.body: [e006:f01] 厚さ1.4mm・約30gの薄型設計 2026 10/23 スマホアクセサリ・ガジェット AULUMU iPhone Duo MagSafe アラミドファイバー スマホケース 2026.10.23 [PR] 本ページでは一部にアフィリエイトリンクを利用しており、購入実績などに基づいて手数料を受領しています。 [e006:f02] ライフスタイルブランド「AULUMU（オルム）」は10月23日、「Apple iPhone Duo」用の『ADuo ドットアラミド繊維スマホケース』を同日より日本国内で発売すると発表しました。 [e006:f03] 価格は通常価格で14,280円（税込）です。 [e006:f04] カラーはブラックとブルーの2色が用意されています。 [e006:f05] 目次 1500D×600Dのアラミドファイバーを採用 素材にはアラミドファイバーとアルミ合金が使われています。 [e006:f06] 外層には高密度で耐久性に優れた1500Dのアラミドファイバー、内層には600Dのアラミドファイバーが採用されています。 [e006:f07] 内層は精密な織り込みによって滑らかな肌触りを狙ったとのことです。 [e006:f08] 均一に編み込まれた素材により、手に馴染む質感と構造強度の両立を目指しているそうです。 [e006:f09] 厚さ1.4mm、重量約30gの薄型・軽量設計 ボディの厚みは1.4mmで、重量は約30gです。 [e006:f10] デュアルスクリーンを覆うフルカバー設計 iPhone Duoのデュアルスクリーン構成に合わせ、フロントスクリーン側には高強度PC製のフレームが採用されています。 [e006:f11] ブラックのみ、黒の中に浮かび上がるドット柄「ゴーストドットデザイン」が採用されています。 [e006:f12] N52ネオジム磁石でMagSafeエコシステムに対応 N52ネオジム磁石アレイを内蔵し、マグネット（MagSafe）に対応しています。 [e006:f13] 「G09 3軸スタンド」をはじめとするAULUMUのエコシステム製品と連動して使えるそうです。 [e006:f14] 製品名：ADuo ドットアラミド繊維スマホケース 対応機種：iPhone Duo カラー：ブラック（ポーラーブラック）、ブルー（アビスブルー） 素材：アラミドファイバー、アルミ合金 サイズ：フロントカバー約120×83×7mm、背面カバー約119.67×83×12.12mm（カメラガードを含む） 重量：約30g 価格：14,280円（税込） サイズは手作業による測定のため、多少の誤差が生じる場合があります。 [e006:f15] 同社は、実際の使用に影響はないとしています。 [e006:f16] ADuo ドットアラミド繊維スマホケース（公式ストア）： https:// 楽天市場で『AULUMU 楽天市場店』をチェックする 『AULUMU（オルム）Amazonストア』をチェックする スマホアクセサリ・ガジェット AULUMU iPhone Duo MagSafe アラミドファイバー スマホケース 目次。

evidence.body: [e007:f01] ハイエンドなギアデザインを展開するライフスタイルブランド「AULUMU」が、Appleが本日発売した「iPhone Duo」向けのアラミド繊維ケース「ADuo ドットアラミド繊維スマホケース」を発売しました。 [e007:f02] アラミド繊維は同質量の鋼鉄よりも5倍強く、ガラス繊維の半分の軽さという特殊素材で、「ADuo ドットアラミド繊維スマホケース」は外層には太めの繊維で高密度で優れた耐久性を実現する1500D（デニール）のアラミド繊維を、内層には心地よい滑らかな肌触りの細めの600Dのアラミド繊維を採用しています。 [e007:f03] また、厚さは1.4㎜と薄く、重さは30gと軽量なのも特徴。 [e007:f04] リアカメラ周りは精密CNC加工と高耐久アルマイト処理が施されたアルミ合金の枠で保護しており、アウターディスプレイ周りには高強度PC製フレームを採用し、四隅やエッジ部分まで余すことなくフルカバーしてくれるケースとなっています。 [e007:f05] 背面にはN52ネオジム磁石アレイを内蔵し、同社のMagSafe対応アクセサリを含む、様々なMagSafe対応アクセサリを利用可能です。 [e007:f06] なお、価格は14,280円（税込）で、現在は公式ストアで購入可能です。 [e007:f07] （将来的には Amazon でも販売されるものと予想されます） ・ ADuo ドットアラミド繊維スマホケース ＜ Google 検索で最新記事を見つけやすく!
